Services

  • Energy and electrification

    Solar and battery feasibility

    Site-specific modelling of electricity consumption, tariffs and solar generation to compare solar and battery system sizes and operating strategies, with estimated savings, payback and net present value.

  • Embodied carbon

    Upfront embodied carbon data preparation

    Preparation of material quantities from bills of quantities for upfront embodied carbon assessment, including material classification, mapping to relevant environmental product declarations or other emissions data, and documentation of assumptions and data gaps for assessor review.

  • Building physics

    Reflected glare assessment

    Site-specific assessment of reflected sunlight from façades and roofs, evaluating potential glare impacts on drivers, pedestrians and occupants of neighbouring buildings to support planning submissions.

  • Building physics

    Condensation risk assessment

    Assessment of condensation and mould growth risk in external wall and roof assemblies to inform material selection and construction detailing.
